notes.title: 10 Years of Night School Studio!
notes.content:
Happy 10 years of Night School Studio! 

A whole decade, huh? That’s a long time to be making games. We’re stoked we’re still here, and even more stoked that [u]you’re[/u] still here. We at Night School know we’re nothing without our incredible community. These 10 years wouldn’t have been possible without [u]you[/u].

From making OXENFREE as a scrappy, tiny ragtag team to joining Netflix and taking our games to new heights, it’s been a ride – and we’re deeply grateful to have had you along every step of the way.

To celebrate and to say thank you, we’re kicking off a couple of fun things this month:

[h2][b]10 Days to Celebrate 10 Years of Night School[/b]
[/h2]
Starting today, Dec 18, 2024, we’ll be giving away exclusive Night School merch and swag every day for the next 10 days. Each piece is a hand-picked nod to our history, featuring designs inspired by our games and the memories they created. All you have to do is fill out a [url=https://bit.ly/NSS10YearGiveaway]Community Survey[/url] that’ll be included in each day’s giveaway post. We’ll select a random winner 24 hours later, and notify them directly. (US residents 18+ only. Sorry!)

[h2][b]Online Gallery[/b]
[/h2]
We’ve also curated an online gallery on our website to commemorate and celebrate all the hard work we’ve accomplished as a studio. Check out never-before-seen concept and production art, and take a walk down memory lane with us! (And each of our games has its own gallery to peruse!)

Whether you’ve been with us since we were just a few folks working at a kitchen table or you recently showed up to the party ‘cause you liked our vibe, we thank you. Thank you, thank you, thank you for playing our games – we can’t wait to keep making them for you.

Here’s to the next 10 years. 

Love,
Night School Studio 

[b]P.S. Be sure to keep your eyes peeled for the giveaways on our [url=https://instagram.com/nightschoolstudio/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/nightschoolers]Twitter[/url], [url=https://facebook.com/nightschoolstudio]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.threads.net/@nightschoolstudio]Threads[/url]![/b]

[b]ONLINE GALLERIES:[/b] [url=https://nightschoolstudio.com/oxenfree#galleryOxenfree]OXENFREE[/url] | [url=https://nightschoolstudio.com/afterparty#galleryAfterparty]Afterparty[/url] | [url=https://nightschoolstudio.com/next-stop-nowhere#galleryNextStopNowhere]Next Stop Nowhere[/url] | [url=https://nightschoolstudio.com/oxenfree-ii#galleryOxenfreeII]OXENFREE II: Lost Signals[/url]

notes.title: Complete your Night School Collection with 60% Off

Just add the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16322/Night_School_Complete_Bundle/]Night School Complete Collection[/url] to your cart!

notes.title: OXENFREE II Arrives July 12, 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315789/3b94c91aa42d05c042e0a4082b7fdacefce6aae8.jpg[/img]
It's time to tune into the next chapter. [b]OXENFREE II: Lost Signals will launch July 12, 2023![/b] Make sure it’s on your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574310/OXENFREE_II_Lost_Signals/]wishlist[/url] so you can be among the first to play.

This game has been a labor of love and we've been fueled by the passion of our community. We're counting down the days until you have the game in your hands. We cannot wait for you to finally meet Riley and make life altering choices while overcoming supernatural challenges that threaten to destroy her future.

[h1]Watch a new trailer.
[/h1]
https://youtu.be/c7AJBSII0Q8

Today, we also debuted an all-new trailer during the Nintendo Indie World Showcase, uncovering new scenes and details from the game. You'll recognize some familiar faces, like Jacob Summers and Riley Poverly as well as some new ones from Camena. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=brNLmMMB-J4]Watch the full segment here[/url].

[h1]Get on the walkie.
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315789/67dffe5819d5c8a7bdbeb78095acbf73476dccbc.jpg[/img]
We also teamed up with the [url=https://blog.playstation.com/2023/04/19/get-your-walkie-talkie-ready-for-oxenfree-ii-lost-signals-launching-july-12/]PlayStation Blog[/url] to dive deeper into our new walkie talkie mechanic, which will allow you to connect with contacts all over Camena. Read the article to uncover details about the radio DJ and sailor that you'll connect with – or not, truly the choice is up to you.

[h1]Speak the local language.
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315789/c4832e57017aa34a05d984fbff480377d524af8d.jpg[/img]
Finally if that wasn't quite enough OXENFREE II news... we have more! OXENFREE II will have localized subtitles and interface support in over 30 languages including: Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian Bokmål, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese, Romanian, Spanish, Spanish (Spain), Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese.

[h1]Stay tuned.
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315789/eea89ebec838362e051e6e30268c36fe7af03a71.jpg[/img]
Thanks for tuning in! We'll have even more updates in the months ahead before July 12 so give us a follow on [url=http://twitter.com/nightschoolers]Twitter[/url], [url=https://instagram.com/nightschoolstudio]Instagram[/url], [url=https://facebook.com/nightschoolstudio]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@nightschoolstudio]TikTok[/url], and [url=https://nightschoolstudio.tumblr.com/]Tumblr[/url] for the latest.

notes.title: What makes a good conversation? Find out at LudoNarraCon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11048438/889aa8f6147d199d676b4f3365840e6356ec8ac6.jpg[/img]
Choosing dialogue choices and having conversations is often part of the core mechanic of any narrative-driven game. How do we craft “good” conversations and what does that mean? 

Join Kahlief Adams, host and founder of the [url=https://campsite.bio/spawnonme]Spawn On Me podcast[/url], as he sits down with Adam Hines, our co-founder and lead writer. Using our catalog of [url=https://nightschoolstudio.com/games/]games[/url], they’ll discuss how writers, narrative designers, and storytellers can build interactive conversations that feel natural and engaging while pushing the boundaries of interpersonal relationships in games.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ludonarracon]Watch the panel at 4PM PST today Friday, May 6th on Steam[/url]. 

[h2]About LudoNarraCon[/h2]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ludonarracon]LudoNarraCon 2022[/url] is the fourth edition of an annual digital festival held exclusively on Steam to celebrate narrative video games and the developers that make them. Conceived and organised by indie label [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller?snr=1_614_615_ludonarracon_1601]Fellow Traveller[/url], the event is available for free to everyone to attend and free for developers to exhibit at.

👀 Behind the scenes content and live Q&As from over 40 exhibiting developers, all making story-rich games
🎮 Over 30 narrative game demos to download and play, all featured in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ludonarracon?tab=2&snr=1_614_615_ludonarracon_1601]demo section[/url]
💸 Get great discounts on more than 140 story-rich games in the LudoNarraCon sale
🎤 Watch over 16 hours of original panels and fireside chats about narrative games and game development
🖼️ Get yourself a wallpaper pack to celebrate the event, featuring tons of cool art from your favourite narrative games

notes.title: Afterparty is coming to Steam on October 22, 2020
notes.content:
Hi! How are you doing? Are you doing okay? How many wellness apps have you deleted and redownloaded in the last two weeks? Do you currently have another tab open to a video explaining how to teach World War II to a nine-year old? Are you growing your own toilet paper? Well better get on it! But before you go over to your neighbor’s house to steal his bleach, I have some actual, verifiable good news! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11048438/99c49cb114e285e2cdf978b6bb74bef7ac911334.gif[/img]

Halloween is around the corner! And in these last waning months, weeks, days and [checks watch] minutes of having a still somewhat functioning civilization, what better way to rest your weary soul than to focus on the comparatively cheerful horrors of Halloween. Costumed children skipping down the street! Raucous parties raging till dawn! Surprise office shindigs to delight young temps! None of that will be happening this year, no, but [b][i]Afterparty[/i] is coming to Steam on October 22,[/b] just in time to fuel all of your spooky cravings in lieu of being able to actually go outside and see other human beings. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/762220/Afterparty/

We’re genuinely very excited to finally bring our follow-up to Oxenfree out to you ghouls, a devilish adventure with Milo and Lola, two college friends who find themselves trapped in Hell. I know. I’m jealous, too. But to them, this is a bad thing! They want to get back to Earth, back to their lives, and, thankfully for them, there's a demonic loophole: while prowling the weird streets of Hell’s surrealist cities, if they can find and outdrink Satan himself, the Prince of Lies will return them to their placid existence. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11048438/68c0101f24a8c0ee204422637b3882958c8980e1.gif[/img]

You'll control both Milo and Lola through a phantasmagorical bar crawl positively brimming with fiendish characters you can befriend and/or torture. You'll drink from over 30 bizarre concoctions that will change the two friends' personalities, allowing you to personalize their crazy night out. You'll survive awkward bar talk, help wayward souls, play beer pong with demons, and try not to throw up even though it would probably just make you feel a whole lot better. Won’t you help Milo and Lola escape eternal torment? If you bring your laptop into bed, you don’t even have to get up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11048438/1d3beb99c037101cd59b6bcd9c09c71fd266aef0.gif[/img]

Okay. That’s it. Get some rest. Close your eyes. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/762220/Afterparty/]Add Afterparty to your Wish List.[/url] Picture a calm, blue ocean. And vote. Thanks. 


- Adam and Night School Studio

https://store.steampowered.com/app/762220/Afterparty/

notes.title: Free New Game Plus Update is Now Available
notes.content:
LEAVE. IS. POSSIBLE.

That's right everyone, today is the day! Oxenfree's NewGame+ content is out now to all players for free. Every owner of the game should now be able to update Oxenfree and experience the continuation of Alex's story. The new mode will allow players to continue beyond the original “ending” into a new and exciting chapter of the game's story. We are incredibly excited to share all of this new content with you today, and can't wait to see what everyone thinks!

Thank you to all of you for supporting the game and our studio. We couldn't have done it without you!

notes.title: Update: 2 Weeks In
notes.content:
Hello Oxenfree Community!

We at Night School Studio just wanted to take a moment and thank everyone here who has purchased and played Oxenfree these past 2 weeks. Its been an incredible experience seeing everyone enjoy this adventure we worked so hard to put together. 

We also want to make sure everyone is aware of the updates currently available for the game. We've already managed to fix several issues players have reported, and plan on continuing to support the game and it's community moving forward. Details on these updates can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/388880/discussions/0/451850468373511139/]here[/url].

Please ensure that you are on the most recent version (v1.3.1) before reporting any errors, and feel free to use the discussion threads for any questions and comments.
